items.description: The rows of the tree, groups and items (a group holds more, to any depth), as a list with one object for each: `tag` and then the element's attributes by name, `text`, `id` (reported by the element's events), `slot` and `children` (objects of the same form). Tags and attributes: `obc-tree-navigation-group` (label, branches, expanded, checked, disabled, terminalType, alerts, href, hasIcon); `obc-tree-navigation-item` (label, branches, expandable, expanded, checked, disabled, terminalType, alerts, href, hasLeadingIcon).

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
